note: The TCF in bands, for /tcf. Structure only; no exam content is reproduced. The tasks in the sets are our own training versions of the skills the TCF tests: the real TCF listening and reading questions are four-option multiple choice, rising in difficulty, and one test covers all levels. Times and word targets are our own. Question counts, scale, optional papers and timings are to verify against France Éducation international. Variants: TCF tout public, TCF IRN (residence and nationality) and TCF Canada.
